strings.zh: 石兰『{VAR:0103:0}大人,{NEWLINE}恭喜！{SCROLL}主人在看到了您{NEWLINE}战斗至此的实力后,{SCROLL}决定让您与城堡首领{CLEAR}进行对战。{SCROLL}做好准备了吗？{SCROLL}

strings.zh: 石兰『欢迎。{SCROLL}我就是城堡守护者{NEWLINE}石兰。{SCROLL}我的主人嘉德丽雅小姐{NEWLINE}是个好强的人⋯⋯{SCROLL}但由于种种原因{NEWLINE}被禁止参加对战。{SCROLL}所以就由我代替{NEWLINE}主人向您挑战。{SCROLL}⋯⋯我石兰{NEWLINE}是不会手下留情的。{SCROLL}那么,开始吧！{NEWLINE}嘿嘿！{SCROLL}
strings.en: Darach: Welcome.{SCROLL}I am Darach, the Castle Valet.{SCROLL}My lady, Lady Caitlin, is a{NEWLINE}fiercely competitive person...{SCROLL}But for various reasons, she{NEWLINE}is forbidden from battling.{SCROLL}Therefore, I shall challenge{NEWLINE}you in my lady’s stead.{SCROLL}...I, Darach, will show you no mercy.{SCROLL}Now, let us begin! Heh heh!{SCROLL}

strings.zh: 石兰『实力还是{NEWLINE}那么强劲啊⋯⋯{SCROLL}{VAR:0103:0}大人,{NEWLINE}真是厉害。{SCROLL}⋯⋯不过我石兰{NEWLINE}在近距离欣赏到您的{SCROLL}战斗之后注意到了。{SCROLL}是什么呢？{SCROLL}训练家的话应该{NEWLINE}要在战斗中学会礼仪！{SCROLL}那么,开始吧！{NEWLINE}哈哈！！{SCROLL}
strings.en: Darach: Your strength is{NEWLINE}as formidable as ever...{SCROLL}{VAR:0103:0}, you are truly remarkable.{SCROLL}...However, having watched{NEWLINE}you battle up close,{SCROLL}I, Darach, noticed something.{SCROLL}What might it be?{SCROLL}A Trainer ought to learn{NEWLINE}etiquette through battle!{SCROLL}Now, let us begin! strings.zh: 石兰『{VAR:0103:0}大人的{NEWLINE}实力真的实在是{CLEAR}太强了！{SCROLL}我继承了我们一族{NEWLINE}悠久的训练家心得都不能{CLEAR}战胜您吗⋯⋯{SCROLL}嘉德丽雅小姐{NEWLINE}看到您的精彩战斗之后{CLEAR}心情也变得愉快了。{SCROLL}{VAR:0103:0}大人,{NEWLINE}请下次再来城堡吧。{SCROLL}我们非常欢迎！{SCROLL}
strings.en: Darach: {VAR:0103:0}, your{NEWLINE}strength is truly overwhelming!{SCROLL}Even the Trainer’s wisdom{NEWLINE}handed down through my family for{CLEAR}generations could not defeat you...{SCROLL}Watching your splendid battle has{NEWLINE}put Lady Caitlin in quite a good mood.{SCROLL}{VAR:0103:0}, please do{NEWLINE}visit the castle again.{SCROLL}You will be most welcome!{SCROLL}

strings.zh: 石兰『原来如此⋯⋯{SCROLL}我感觉到的{NEWLINE}弱点是我的错觉吗⋯⋯{SCROLL}还是在战斗的时候{NEWLINE}修正了呢⋯⋯{SCROLL}不管怎么样,{NEWLINE}都要恭喜您！{SCROLL}虽然嘴巴上不说,{NEWLINE}但其实嘉德丽雅小姐{CLEAR}也是非常欣赏您的战斗。{SCROLL}为了小姐,{NEWLINE}您今后也要再来城堡啊！{SCROLL}
strings.en: Darach: I see...{SCROLL}Was the weakness I sensed{NEWLINE}merely my imagination...{SCROLL}Or did you correct it in{NEWLINE}the midst of battle...?{SCROLL}Either way, congratulations!{SCROLL}Though she will not say so, Lady Caitlin{NEWLINE}truly admires the way you battle.{SCROLL}For my lady’s sake, please{NEWLINE}do come back to the castle!{SCROLL}
